traps.summary: Lease auto-renews for a full year unless notice is given far in advance.
evidence: This Lease automatically renews for a new 12-month term unless Tenant delivers written notice of non-renewal by certified mail at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term.

traps.summary: Tenant pays the first part of every repair regardless of cause.
evidence: Tenant is responsible for the first $300 of the cost of any repair to the Premises, regardless of the cause of the damage.

traps.summary: Landlord may enter at any time without notice.
evidence: Landlord may enter the Premises at any time and without prior notice for inspections, repairs, or showings.

traps.summary: Two sections disagree about when rent is late and what the fee is.
evidence: Rent received after the 5th day of the month is subject to a late fee of 5% of the monthly rent.
Rent not received by the 2nd day of the month is delinquent and subject to a late charge of $75 plus $15 for each additional day.

deadlines.label: Return signed move-in condition checklist
deadlines.evidence: Tenant must return the signed move-in condition checklist to Landlord within 7 days after move-in; otherwise the Premises are deemed to be in good condition.

deadlines.label: Deliver proof of renter's insurance
deadlines.evidence: Tenant shall deliver proof of renter's insurance to Landlord within 10 days after the start of the term.

traps.summary: Early termination accelerates all remaining rent with no duty to re-rent.
evidence: If Tenant terminates this Lease early for any reason, Tenant shall owe all rent remaining through the end of the term, and Landlord has no duty to re-rent the Premises.

traps.summary: Part of the deposit is declared non-refundable.
evidence: Of the deposit, $400 is a non-refundable cleaning fee that Landlord keeps regardless of the condition of the Premises.

traps.summary: Tenant pays landlord's attorney fees regardless of who wins.
evidence: Tenant shall pay Landlord's reasonable attorney's fees in any dispute arising under this Lease, regardless of which party prevails.

traps.summary: Two sections disagree about how fast the deposit is returned.
evidence: Landlord shall return the deposit, less lawful deductions for unpaid rent and damage beyond normal wear and tear, within 21 days after Tenant vacates and returns all keys.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this Lease, Landlord shall return any security deposit within 60 days after Tenant vacates.

traps.summary: Subletting, including short-term rentals, triggers termination and a penalty.
evidence: Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or any part of it, including through short-term rental platforms, and any violation is grounds for immediate termination and a penalty of $1,000.

traps.summary: Landlord allocates shared utility costs at its sole discretion.
evidence: Tenant shall pay a share of common-area water, sewer, and trash charges, as allocated by Landlord in its sole discretion.

traps.summary: Jury trial waiver and binding arbitration with tenant paying arbitrator fees.
evidence: Tenant waives the right to a jury trial and agrees that all disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration, with Tenant paying the arbitrator's fees.

traps.summary: Landlord can raise rent on renewal by up to a fixed percentage.
evidence: Upon each renewal, Landlord may increase the monthly rent by up to 8% with 30 days' written notice.

traps.summary: Recurring pet rent plus a non-refundable per-animal fee.
evidence: If Landlord consents to a pet, Tenant shall pay monthly pet rent of $50 per animal and a non-refundable pet fee of $500 per animal.

traps.summary: Guests are limited to a few nights per month.
evidence: Any guest who stays more than 5 nights in a calendar month is considered an unauthorized occupant and requires Landlord's written approval.
